from skimage.feature import peak_local_max
def detect_centers(s, xrange=(210,1082), tube=18, thr=25, mindist=7, dtmin=2.7):
    d=color_dist(series_specs[s]['color_hex'])
    mask=(d<thr).astype(np.uint8)
    # tube around path
    x0=210
    tube_mask=np.zeros_like(mask)
    p=paths[s]
    for x in range(max(xrange[0],210),min(xrange[1],1081)):
        y=int(round(p[x-x0]))
        tube_mask[max(0,y-tube):min(mask.shape[0],y+tube+1),x]=1
    m=mask*tube_mask
    dt=cv2.distanceTransform(m,cv2.DIST_L2,5)
    coords=peak_local_max(dt,min_distance=mindist,threshold_abs=dtmin,exclude_border=False)
    coords=coords[(coords[:,1]>=xrange[0])&(coords[:,1]<xrange[1])]
    return [(float(x),float(y),float(dt[int(y),int(x)])) for y,x in coords],dt,m
